g.text: runOnce (at startup, then hourly), single instance lock
archive PUBLISHED and CANCELLED events whose end passed (J3 D3)
set liftedAt and liftedBy + outbox notice
re-check it is still untouched (skip if edited)
delete its images (missing file is fine)
API keys unused 166 days without notice:
API keys unused 180 days and notified: revoke + activity entry (I1)
with no active suspension: delete their images first
invitations, keys and closed removal disputes (F2, S1)
purge activity entries older than 12 months
purge reports, decisions, suspensions and disputes
closed or lifted over 12 months ago, unless backing
an active suspension, a hidden event or an open dispute (DF5)
unverified accounts aged 23 days without reminder:
[each unverified account aged 30 days and reminded]
re-check still unverified, then delete it as UC6 effects
delete outbox failures older than 30 days (DF1)
done (each step resumable on next run)
Every step is a bounded batch and idempotent:
a crash mid-run is safe, the next run continues.
Emails only go through the outbox (Q2).
